title: 2011 Prairie's turret now matches both of its pictures
items: The round turret at 2011 Prairie now has five small square windows around its top, running from one side of the tower to the other, where it used to have three bunched on the north side. The 1890s photograph from the north and the 1895 magazine plate from the south each show three of them, and each now sees three in the model at the same spacing.
The windows are cut plainly into the stone, with no sill or lintel of their own, as both pictures show them. The house now matches both of its pictures closely enough to sign it off.
